title: Maplewood Canada Open-World Life Sim — Roblox-Style Homepage + 3D Game

requirements.text: Build a Roblox-style homepage with TRXGAMING branding. Display a featured game card for 'Maplewood Canada' with a thumbnail, title, play count, and a large 'Play' button. Style the homepage with a dark gaming aesthetic matching Roblox's TRXGAMING creator page: bold fonts, neon accent colors, animated banners, and a navigation bar with logo, search, and user avatar placeholder.

quotes: Build an app similar style to Roblox by TRXGAMING the homepage but when you press play, there's only one game

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage renders a TRXGAMING-branded header with logo and navigation
A single game card for 'Maplewood Canada' is displayed with thumbnail, title, and play count
Clicking 'Play' transitions the user into the 3D game view
Dark gaming theme with neon accents is consistently applied

requirements.text: Render a large open-world 3D map using Three.js / React Three Fiber representing Maplewood, Canada. The map must include: the city of Maplewood (downtown, commercial blocks, airport), the neighborhood Mapleville, mountain ranges surrounding the town with a ski resort, dense forests with choppable trees, rivers, lakes, and a swimming/beach resort area. The world should feel vast — use procedural terrain, fog of distance, and LOD techniques to simulate miles of explorable land.

quotes: large and huge map
miles and miles of forest and rivers at lakes
ski resort in the mountains surrounding the town and the neighborhood Mapleville in the city Maplewood

acceptanceCriteria: 3D world renders with distinct zones: city, neighborhood, mountains, forest, rivers, lakes
Terrain transitions naturally between biomes
Ski resort is visible in mountain area
Swimming resort and lakes are present
Forest contains tree meshes that respond to chop interactions
Airport area is identifiable on the map

requirements.text: Implement a player character controller with first-person and third-person camera toggle (keyboard shortcut or UI button). The player must be able to walk, run, jump, swim, fly (superhuman mode toggle), drive vehicles, and perform interaction actions: pick up objects, drink consumables, eat food, touch/interact with world objects and NPCs.

quotes: toggle from first person to second person
ability to pick up things and drink things and touch stuff
become superhuman fly

acceptanceCriteria: Player can switch between first-person and third-person camera with a keybind or button
WASD / arrow key movement works in both modes
Interaction prompt appears when near interactable objects (food, drinks, doors, NPCs, vehicles)
Player can pick up, consume, and interact with world items
Superhuman/flight mode can be toggled from a settings or ability menu
Player can swim in water bodies

requirements.text: Populate the world with hundreds of NPCs, each with distinct AI behavior, dialogue lines, and daily routines (eating, working, walking, socializing, attending parties). When some NPCs are killed, reinforcement NPCs spawn and react (flee, fight back, or call for help depending on their role). NPCs inside every building and house must be present and active.

quotes: hundreds of NPC's
NPC's are real realistic and do everything
more come if you kill some some of them flights, each of them have different responsibilities and things they say and do

acceptanceCriteria: At least representative NPC types render across the map: civilians, workers, shop owners, party-goers
Each NPC type has unique dialogue and behavioral routines
Killing or attacking NPCs triggers a reinforcement/alert response from nearby NPCs
NPCs are present inside enterable buildings and houses
NPCs navigate with basic pathfinding (avoid obstacles, enter/exit buildings)

requirements.text: Implement AI-driven animals across the forest, mountain, and lake zones. Some animals are passive (deer, birds, fish) and some are dangerous (bears, wolves). Animals roam, flee from the player, or attack depending on their type and proximity. Include choppable trees in the forest that fall when interacted with.

quotes: There's animals there's AI some animals are dangerous
trees you can chop down

acceptanceCriteria: Multiple animal types render in appropriate biomes
Passive animals flee when the player approaches
Dangerous animals (e.g. bear, wolf) attack the player within aggro range
Trees in the forest have a chop interaction that plays a falling animation and removes the tree

requirements.text: Implement a life-simulation system allowing the player to: take on jobs (police officer, SWAT, dealership worker, first responder, and others), own and customize a home (Brookhaven-inspired but more realistic), have family relationships with NPCs, eat and drink to manage hunger/thirst stats, and engage in everyday human activities.

quotes: eat drink and do everything that regular humans do have families have homes get jobs
houses similar to the game in Brookhaven, but more realistic and cool

acceptanceCriteria: Player can select a job from a job board or career menu
Hunger and thirst stats are tracked and displayed in a HUD
Player can own a home and access a basic interior customization menu
Family/relationship status with NPCs can be formed through interactions
Job-specific activities (patrol route for police, test drives for dealership) are functional

requirements.text: Implement police officer, SWAT team, and first responder career paths. Police officers have patrol routes on the map. SWAT responds to high-alert situations. First responders (ambulance/fire) respond to emergencies. Players in these roles receive role-specific equipment, vehicles, and mission objectives.

quotes: ability to become a police officer, complete police officer patrol, and SWAT team

acceptanceCriteria: Player can enroll as police officer, SWAT member, or first responder from a career selection screen
Police officers have a defined patrol route with waypoints on the map
SWAT role is unlocked during high-crime events
First responders receive emergency call notifications
Role-specific uniforms, vehicles, and equipment are assigned on role selection

requirements.text: Implement a criminal and chaotic gameplay system: players can rob NPCs and stores, acquire weapons and explosives, commit violent acts, and cause chaos. Include a wanted/alert level system that escalates police NPC responses as the player commits crimes.

quotes: become a violent robber or just go crazy start blowing up stuff and killing

acceptanceCriteria: Player can interact with NPCs to rob them
Explosives and weapons can be used to cause destruction in the world
A wanted level indicator (stars or similar) escalates with criminal acts
Higher wanted levels spawn more aggressive police/SWAT NPC responses
Violence toggle in settings can restrict gore/violent content

requirements.text: Implement a comprehensive vehicle system with land vehicles (cars, trucks, motorcycles), sea vehicles (boats, jet skis), and air vehicles (helicopters, planes). Include a car dealership building where the player can browse, purchase, and optionally work as an employee. The airport supports plane and helicopter takeoff/landing.

quotes: boats vehicles, air land, and sea there's a airport
dealership you can even work at the dealership

acceptanceCriteria: At least one land, one sea, and one air vehicle type are drivable by the player
Car dealership building is enterable and displays purchasable vehicles
Player can take a job as a dealership worker
Airport has a runway and supports aircraft takeoff/landing mechanics
Vehicles have basic physics (acceleration, turning, collision)

requirements.text: Make every building and house in the world enterable. Each interior must contain NPC characters, interactive objects (furniture, food items, appliances), and appropriate room layouts. This includes homes, shops, the dealership, hotels, resort buildings, police station, airport terminal, and party venues.

quotes: buildings that you can go into every single one of the buildings and houses and there's people in there

acceptanceCriteria: Entering any building transitions seamlessly to an interior scene
Each interior type (home, shop, hotel, police station) has a unique layout
NPCs are present and active inside interiors
Interactive objects (sit, eat, pick up) exist inside buildings
Player can exit buildings and return to the open world

requirements.text: Implement a weapons and accessories system spanning multiple time periods (historical, modern, futuristic). Include melee weapons, firearms, explosives, and superhuman abilities. Players can equip accessories (clothing, armor, gadgets). Display an inventory/loadout UI for managing equipped items.

quotes: multiple weapons and accessories, mini women's and accessories from different times
become superhuman fly

acceptanceCriteria: Inventory UI shows equipped weapons and accessories
At least one weapon from each era (historical, modern, futuristic) is available
Weapons have distinct attack animations and effects
Accessories can be equipped and visually appear on the player character
Superhuman ability (flight, super speed, etc.) can be toggled from inventory or ability menu

requirements.text: Build a social features system including: a friends list (add/remove players), a social feed or profile page per player, in-game text chat (global and proximity), and a voice chat indicator UI. The social system should feel like an in-game social network similar to Roblox's friend system.

quotes: friending people and adding people and playing with people on the game is more like a social media thing you can chat you can do voice chat or type to chat

acceptanceCriteria: Player profile page shows username, avatar, and friends list
Send/accept/remove friend requests is functional
Text chat UI is always accessible with a chat bubble toggle
Voice chat status indicator shows which players have mic active
Friends can be invited to join the same game session

requirements.text: Implement a settings panel accessible from the main menu and in-game pause menu. Settings must include: violence toggle (on/off), camera mode default (first/third person), graphics quality, chat preferences, and controls remapping. Persist player settings in backend stable storage.

quotes: ability to toggle setting and violence in the game

acceptanceCriteria: Settings panel is accessible from both the homepage and in-game pause menu
Violence toggle disables/enables blood and explicit combat visuals
Camera mode default persists across sessions
Settings are saved to the backend and restored on next login

requirements.text: Implement social event locations on the map: parties (indoor and outdoor), pool parties, hotel events, ski resort gatherings, and rowdy street events. These locations should be active with NPC crowds, music ambiance, and interactive party props (drinks, food, music, dance floor).

quotes: there's parties there's pools there's a ski resort
There's parties there's rowdy things that happen

acceptanceCriteria: At least one active party venue renders with crowd NPCs and ambiance
Pool area is accessible with swimming interaction
Ski resort has skiable slopes with player ski mechanic
Hotel lobbies are enterable with check-in NPC
Party locations include interactive food/drink props

requirements.text: Apply a bold, immersive gaming visual theme across the entire frontend. Use a dark background palette with vibrant neon-orange and red accent colors, blocky/futuristic typography, animated UI elements (hover glows, slide-ins), and a HUD overlay during gameplay showing health, hunger, thirst, wanted level, mini-map, and equipped item. The style should evoke a high-energy Roblox-meets-GTA aesthetic.

quotes: similar style to Roblox by TRXGAMING

acceptanceCriteria: Homepage uses dark background with neon-orange/red accent colors consistently
Typography is bold and gaming-style throughout
In-game HUD displays health bar, hunger, thirst, wanted stars, mini-map, and inventory slot
UI hover states include glow or highlight animations
The overall aesthetic is cohesive from homepage to gameplay screen

requirements.text: Store player profiles, friend relationships, settings, and game progression data in the Motoko backend. Expose actor methods for: creating/fetching player profiles, managing friend requests, saving/loading player settings, and tracking owned homes and vehicles.

quotes: friending people and adding people
have homes
get jobs

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes createProfile, getProfile, updateSettings, addFriend, acceptFriend, removeFriend methods
Player-owned homes and vehicles are stored and retrievable per profile
Friend request state (pending, accepted) is tracked in stable storage
Settings object is stored per player and returned on profile fetch

constraints: All backend logic must remain in a single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo)
No external databases or cloud services; all persistence through Motoko stable storage
Voice chat UI is an indicator only — actual real-time audio transport is not implemented (platform limitation)
Multiplayer session synchronization is simulated client-side; no WebSocket backend
Immutable frontend paths (hooks, ui components) must not be modified
nonGoals: Real-time multiplayer synchronization via WebSockets (not supported)
Actual voice chat audio transport (not supported)
Integration with actual Roblox platform APIs

required: TRXGAMING logo badge — bold blocky text 'TRXGAMING' on a dark background with neon orange glow (trxgaming-logo.dim_400x120.png)
Maplewood Canada game thumbnail — aerial view of a Canadian city with mountains, forest, and a river at golden hour (maplewood-thumbnail.dim_800x450.png)
Homepage hero banner — wide dark cityscape of Maplewood at night with neon lights and mountains in the background (hero-banner.dim_1600x600.png)
Mini-map background texture — dark stylized top-down city grid overlay (minimap-bg.dim_256x256.png)
Forest biome environment tile — dense green pine trees on dark ground, tiling texture (forest-tile.dim_512x512.png)
Mountain ski resort scenery — snowy mountain peaks with ski lodge and slopes (ski-resort.dim_800x450.png)
Player HUD health/stat bar background — dark semi-transparent panel with neon orange outlines (hud-panel.dim_512x128.png)
